animations.description: Sound moves around the listener. Light: the sound sweeps from the left, over the top, to the right: each arc in turn pushes in toward the listener and springs back. Strong: the whole sound field winds back, then travels a full turn around the listener, overshoots and settles where it started.

icons.name: tuning-fork
icons.heading: Tuning fork
icons.description: The fork is struck and rings. Light: a tap jolts the fork, its prongs ring (spreading and closing in a decaying vibration) and a pair of sound arcs leave the prong tips and fade as they travel out. Strong: the fork is raised and struck hard, the prongs ring wider and longer, and two waves of arcs leave in turn.
